caption:
The inventors tried to sell Bubble Wrap as wallpaper. It flopped. Then it found its real job: protecting stuff (and our stress levels). 🫧 Be honest, can you resist popping it? 👇

Source: Wikipedia

#DidYouKnow #BubbleWrap #ProductStory #Marketing #Pivot

post.news: Did you know? Bubble Wrap was first invented in 1957 as textured wallpaper.
post.take: Nobody wanted it on their walls. Everybody wanted to pop it. Know your audience.
